_about: What each way of running Kiboto can do. This file is the one source: docs/FEATURES.md and docs/features.html are written from it by scripts/feature_matrix.py, and a test fails when they are behind. A feature with an id is also read by the app (backend/edition_features.json), so its cards say what this page says. A change that adds, removes, repairs or breaks a feature on any of the three columns changes this file in the same commit.

columns.name: Kiboto Companion beside another NAS system
columns.about: The container on Unraid, TrueNAS SCALE, Proxmox, FygoOS, UGOS or ZettOS. That system keeps running the drives and the machine.

columns.name: Kiboto Companion on plain Linux
columns.about: The container on Debian, Ubuntu or any Docker host with no NAS system of its own.

columns.name: Kiboto OS
columns.about: A machine of its own: Debian 13 set up by the Kiboto OS install image. Kiboto runs the drives and the machine. In beta.

features.name: Storage pools: create, grow, see their health
features.note: On plain Linux Kiboto makes new pools but does not take over pools that already exist.

features.name: Replace a failed drive from the app
features.note: ZFS and btrfs pools that keep a second copy rebuild onto an empty drive from the app. Tried on a virtual machine, not yet with a real drive.

features.name: A private folder for each person
Settings copy on the pools, to rebuild after a new system disk
Merged folders across fast and large drives
features.note: On Kiboto OS the merge, the nightly move and the watch on opened files are tried on a virtual machine, not yet over weeks on a real one.

features.name: Copies of a pool to another machine (replication)
features.note: On Kiboto OS a copy to another machine signs in with a key of its own, shown when you make the job.

features.name: File Explorer, previews and share links
Kib: answers from your own files, on your own hardware
People, roles and sign-in with a second step
Kiboto updates with a way back
features.note: Kiboto OS follows the Stable and Beta channels; the container can also follow Edge.

features.name: System updates: kernel, ZFS, Docker
features.note: Kiboto OS installs Debian's security fixes by itself, the kernel included, and never restarts the machine for them. ZFS and Docker move to versions a release was tested with.

features.name: Network settings
features.note: Kiboto OS changes the address and the bridge for virtual machines, with a way back.

features.name: Firewall
features.note: On after an install from Kiboto's USB image; on other installs off until you turn it on. Your home network reaches everything, and the outside only what you tick, apps included.

features.name: Power schedule: wake and sleep at set times
features.note: On Kiboto OS it is tried on a virtual machine, not yet for a night on a real one.

features.name: Battery backup (UPS)
features.note: On Kiboto OS a UPS on a USB cable is read without root; not yet tried with a real UPS on Kiboto OS.

features.name: Server name, time zone and the SSH switch
Dynamic DNS, HTTPS certificates, access from away

groups.name: Front panel hardware (Zettlab D4, D6 and D8 Ultra)

features.name: Fans: curves, quiet at night, fan stop while drives sleep
features.note: On the D4 the kernel keeps the fans, and Kiboto shows them.

features.name: Light bar
features.note: The Zettlab D4's too, without the rainbow effect.

features.name: Front screen
features.note: Kiboto OS draws the screen with the plain renderer. The D4's screen is not drawn yet.

features.name: Card copies from the SD and microSD slots
Fan watchdog beside the app
features.note: On Kiboto OS it runs in the machine's root service, which outlives a web process that hangs.

features.name: Installed as
features.os: An install image for a USB stick, or a script on Debian 13

features.name: Move to Kiboto OS from the container
features.note: Import the pools, then restore a settings backup made in the container: people, passwords and shares come along, and each share is pointed at the pool that holds its folder. Drilled on a virtual machine, not yet on a real one.
